info.title: LC Management API
info.description: LC Management System API - Complete system for managing contracts, buyers, and orders with cost tracking. Includes contract management, order processing, cost analysis, and comprehensive reporting capabilities.

get.description: Returns a list of all buyers (id and name only) sorted alphabetically. Used for dropdown selections.
Returns paginated list of contracts with summary statistics. Supports search by buyer name/contract number and filter by status.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by buyer name or contract number

post.description: Creates a new contract with validation. Contract number must be unique and follow format IIC/AKCL/CON/YYYY/NN

422.description: Validation error or duplicate contract number

get.description: Returns a single contract with buyer details
Generates the next available contract number for a given year in format IIC/AKCL/CON/YYYY/NN

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Year for contract number generation (4 digits, 2000-2100)

get.description: Returns paginated list of orders with search and filter capabilities

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by order number, buyer name, or contract number

post.description: Creates a new order with cost details and totals

get.description: Returns a single order with all details including cost breakdown

put.description: Updates an existing order with new data

items.example: The contract no field is required.

cost_details.description: Array of cost items (YARN, Knitting, Dyeing, etc.)

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Order management endpoints - Create, read, update, and delete orders with cost tracking
